source_exposure: All responses already exposed. New SI display/QC only; no new response validation, fitting, altered selection/weights, mechanism, or corrected prediction.

artifact_definitions.selection: Copy original audit terminal assignments by leg and unique sample ID. Show source data-record/unique-ID counts, shared/nonshared IDs, every original ordered status including zero categories, accepted depth-union unique bottles, original primary unique bottles and memberships. No eligibility conditions are rerun.
artifact_definitions.semantics: Terminal audit categories are mutually exclusive as reported because original if/elif assigns the first matching status. Underlying possible failure causes are not mutually exclusive and later causes are not evaluated after an early assignment. Counts are a sequential classification of file records/IDs, not cause-specific independent rates or independent study counts.
checks: Raw IDs unique; original audit ID universe exactly equals raw ID union
All shared raw line locators agree with audit
Original primary IDs remain subset of original accepted union; 24/55 unique IDs
Each primary row retains original membership count; boundary memberships not independent bottles

artifact_definitions.selection: Exactly twelve variant=primary rows. Compute e_model squared minus e_reference squared with Fraction from original serialized decimal signed-error tokens; retain original tokens, exact terminating decimals and rational numerator/denominator.
artifact_definitions.semantics: For fixed original layer-mean errors only, arbitrary nonnegative normalized depth weights yield a weighted-MSE difference equal to the weighted sum of the twelve per-leg d terms. All strictly positive terms establish strictly worse model MSE/RMSE for every such weight vector; mixed signs preclude invariant ordering and permit either ordering via concentrating weight. No weight is chosen/optimized and no new weighted score is calculated.
boundaries: Stored point-estimate token arithmetic, not increased physical measurement precision
No extension to RSD scenarios, continuous error boxes, geographical areas, modified intra-layer weights or bottle-level RMSE

artifact_definitions.selection: The source annotation CSV has48rows across four variants. Copy only its original twelve variant=primary rows; match original layer numeric tokens/IDs. Copy original alpha and observed-pH directional labels, check them against extrema of the original six means in the original annotation JSON. Export the within/outside 2x2 counts separately by leg and for all twelve layer rows.
artifact_definitions.semantics: The axes use six global calibration-layer means, not the full feature range of1755source-compilation records or all source bottles. Endpoints remain inclusive. The rectangle is descriptive, not a joint validity region. Observed target pH is required, so it is not an advance suitability rule.
prohibitions: Do not use predicted pH for the observed-pH axis
No threshold change, row deletion, new within-domain score, new subset validation or causal interpretation
The known joint-within row may only link back to its already stored layer result in later writing; this script does not compute a subset score

status_semantics_reference.purpose: Source code read by author to confirm audit meanings; runtime scientific reads are restricted to eight exact inputs above.

execution_contract.root_action_before_execution: Read complete new exporter and this draft. Freeze an approved plan copy with status=ROOT_FROZEN,frozen=true,frozen_by=root,frozen_at_utc and approved exact script/input SHA values. Author has not run or imported exporter.
refusal_rules: Unexpected role/path/SHA, source fields/IDs/labels, changed primary membership
Existing output directory or any output different from exact new approved directory
Changed plan, script or source bytes before first output write
execution_contract.write_rule: Construct all artifacts in memory, then exclusively create new output directory. Never overwrite old outputs. Retain partial failed output rather than retry/overwrite silently.
execution_contract.manifest_rule: input_manifest includes approved plan/script/input SHA and definitions. output_manifest hashes all other output files and explicitly omits its own recursive SHA.

counting_rule.meaning: Export alone counts as neither a paper iteration nor a review cycle. Only later substantive manuscript incorporation and rereview can qualify within the root counting rules.

author_preparation: Read actual source CSV headers and annotation rows; observed four terminal status values in actual audit, while preserving all eight possible ordered original statuses with zero rows.
Read original prepare_pairs if/elif logic; confirmed sequential terminal-category semantics.
Read original metadata arrays containing six alpha and six pH means; no source refetch or new thresholds.
Wrote new exporter and this draft only. Did not execute/import exporter, run its summaries, or create its output directory.
root_review: Read complete script/draft. Approved8boundinputs, orderedstatuspartitionnotcause-specificrates, all12storedprimarypoint-error contrasts with exactFraction signs only, and originalsix-calibration-mean rectangle labels without newsubsetscores/selection. No model fitting or validation. Outputpathis task-relative and originalfiles read-only.
